pr_body:
The `MetadataIndexAliasesService` was submitting the cluster state update tasks unbatched with priority `URGENT`. This PR is an attempt to fix this.

Closes: #89924.
pr_comments: @dakrone & @DaveCTurner , I had some time on Friday and I wanted to give this a try to improve my knowledge on different parts of our domain. If you have a moment I would appreciate your input, if you are too busy let me know :).
@DaveCTurner thank you for the feedback and the tips, I will work on testing the executor too.
The test I added wasn't working properly from the beginning. Working on it. An updated version will come soon.

@DaveCTurner thank you for taking another look, the code improved a lot because of your suggestions. Furthermore, I fixed the test which wasn't doing what I thought was doing and I improved my understanding. I am very grateful. Since this relates to a recent issue we discussed with @original-brownbear , I am adding him in this PR as a reviewer.

LGTM, just for posterity.

The latest customer issue that motivated work on this did not only show problems due to not batching these tasks, but also problems from just extremely slowness in the tasks themselves. -> https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/92609
I won't get a chance to give this a final look soon so don't wait for me 🙂

issue_context.title: `MetadataIndexAliasesService` submits unbatched tasks at URGENT priority
issue_context.body:
As the title says. These tasks should be batched because they can arise from ILM actions.

Relates #77466

review_comments: Previously the task was an `AckedClusterStateUpdateTask` and I think we want to keep that behaviour. That means using `success(ClusterStateAckListener clusterStateAckListener)` instead of `success(Runnable onPublicationSuccess)`, which will give you a place to implement the missing plumbing.
Thank you for the tip, it took me a bit but I think now I understand how they connect and what I was missing with the previous implementation.

We could technically just make this a subclass of `org.elasticsearch.cluster.AckedClusterStateUpdateTask` and call the `execute` method (that would just forward to `applyAliasActions`) that we'd have to implement in `executeTask` and make this way shorter I think?
I think I'd rather not do this, `AckedClusterStateUpdateTask` is the unbatched one. Maybe we can do a follow-up that introduces a new abstraction here.
Sorry about the noise then, makes sense :)
I liked that we didn't have to forward to `applyAliasActions` anymore the way the code was, but implementing the all the methods of the listener was tedious. So, I will implement this suggestion.
Ah I didn't realize this. I will revert the change.
